text:
olivia: Quick check — vendor says they can free 4 x A100s in us-west2 for our demo window next Tue 09:00 PT. Can infra confirm quota + the PR for the pool? Also need a quick LGTM on terraform change: https://github.com/rw-infer/infra/pull/412
raj: on it. checking quota now, pinging @alloc-bot for current snapshot
alloc-bot: current_quota_snapshot(us-west2): A100=12 total, 8 used, 4 available. preemptible_slots=6.
lee: skimmed the PR, looks fine functionally — small naming nit. I can push a tidy commit.
sara: vendor ETA sounds good. question: do we want reserved capacity or burst? if reserved, finance needs rough commit numbers.
nora: finance here — heads-up needed if reserved. what's the expected monthly commit?
olivia: rough traffic for demo ~250k tokens/day. ballpark compute: ~1 node-month ~= $5k/mo. if reserved, target 1 rack (4 GPUs) for predictable perf.
raj: quota checked — region has pending maintenance Wed 02:00 PT but it won't affect Tue demo window. we have the free quota.
lee: pushed rename to the PR, ran terraform plan locally. plan snippet:
```
+ redwood_gpu_pool.demo
    size: 4
    sku: A100-40GB
```
No VPC changes.
alloc-bot: soft-hold applied for window Tue 08:30-12:00 PT; token: hold-1732468100. To confirm run: `/hold confirm 1732468100`.
olivia: thanks. @lee please mark PR ready-for-merge after CI, @raj confirm node images will be baked and smoke-tested.
lee: CI passed, marking ready-for-merge. :white_check_mark:
raj: image bake queued, smoke test scheduled Mon 19:00 PT (smoke job link: https://ci.redwood/testruns/9876).
nora: finance gives temp approval for demo spend up to $6k pending final commit sign.
sara: vendor asked for a single contact for handoff — olivia can you share the on-call?
olivia: shared vendor contact in DM and added to the PR description.
alloc-bot: reminder snapshot at 1732468300 -> A100 available now 3 (one allocated by soft-hold).
olivia: any blockers left? planning to merge PR tonight unless objections.
lee: no blockers from infra side.
raj: no blockers from quota or bake.
olivia: merging in 30m unless someone yells. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
